question: The 10th Women's Hockey Asia Cup was held at _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muscat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Women's Hockey Asia Cup **is a **women's international field **hockey tournament organized by the **Asian Hockey Federation**.
 
• **The winning team **becomes the **champion of Asia **and qualifies for the **FIH Hockey World Cup**. 
 
• **Japanese **the defending **champion winning the 2022 edition.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​The **2022 Women's Hockey Asia Cup** was the 10th edition of the Women's Hockey Asia Cup, the quadrennial international women's field hockey championship of Asia organized by the Asian Hockey Federation. It was held from 21 to 28 January 2022 at the Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex in Muscat, Oman.
 
• The tournament was originally scheduled to be held in **Bangkok, Thailand but on 29 December 2021,** the tournament was moved to Muscat, Oman.
 
• India was the defending champions. Japan won its third title after a final win over South Korea.
 
• Eight teams participated in the tournament they are: **China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, and Thailand.**
